title: Runtime authority — packed standalone CLI + canonical evidence import
method: Static + runtime verification of dist/better-harness/standalone.js build output, npm tarball inventory, installed-package lifecycle, three-OS CI gate, and the transactional canonical evidence import path (tests/canonical-harness-evidence-import.test.ts, tests/harness-production-isolation.test.ts, tests/better-harness/packed-standalone-cli.test.ts).
summary: The Better Harness dev/QA runtime is delivered exclusively as a packed standalone CLI (compiled dist/better-harness/standalone.js, no TypeScript source fallback in installed packages) gated across ubuntu/macos/windows in CI, and harness evidence enters the canonical orchestration store only through a transactional, idempotent canonical evidence importer bound to the authoritative canonical run + current SHA. The production plugin keeps exactly one writable orchestration authority.

entries.build_command: bun build src/better-harness/standalone.ts --outdir dist/better-harness --target node --format esm
entries.loader: bin/better-harness.js imports only the compiled module; TypeScript source is NOT a runtime fallback
entries.tarball_lifecycle: npm pack ships package/dist/better-harness/standalone.js + package/bin/better-harness.js; installed via npm install --prefix <dir> --ignore-scripts <tarball>; binary resolves at node_modules/.bin/flowdeck-better-harness
entries.ci_gate: .github/workflows/ci.yml packed-standalone-cli job on [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest] + main Test Matrix
entries.runtime_behavior: per-instance state-dir only; never touches canonical task_runs/assignments/completion_decisions/events/event_outbox
entries.test_evidence: tests/better-harness/packed-standalone-cli.test.ts (6/6), CI Packed Standalone CLI + Installer + Local Installer (all OSes) jobs

entries.run_lookup: authoritative CanonicalRunReader (SqliteCanonicalRunReader over task_runs); caller run id never trusted; unknown/arbitrary run-like strings rejected with CANONICAL_RUN_NOT_FOUND
entries.sha_validation: run.current_sha non-empty (RUN_CURRENT_SHA_MISSING) and === requested sha (RUN_SHA_MISMATCH) === report sourceRevision (REPORT_SHA_MISMATCH / REPORT_SOURCE_REVISION_MISSING)
entries.eligibility: states created/planning/analysing/delegating/executing/verifying/recovering; terminal runs rejected (RUN_NOT_ELIGIBLE); newer-report-supersedes rejected (REPORT_SUPERSEDED)
entries.criterion_validation: criterion in acceptance_criteria with contract_id === run.contractId (CRITERION_CONTRACT_MISMATCH) and run_acceptance_criteria row bound to run (CRITERION_RUN_MISMATCH)
entries.idempotency: deterministic importIdempotencyKey per source item + evidenceIdFromImportKey; scoped INSERT OR IGNORE into command_idempotency inside the transaction (owner=fpx:<sha>); completed → replay, executing → in_progress, failed → re-acquire, acquired → proceed
entries.provenance: 13 fields persisted as canonical JSON in evidence.description (canonicalRunId, targetSha, harnessRunId, reportFingerprint, reportGeneratedAt, harnessFindingId, harnessEvidenceId, sourceEvidenceFingerprint, sourceCategory, sourceCollectedAt, contentHash, importIdempotencyKey, importedAt, provenanceVersion:1); frozen tr_evidence_immutable_update/delete make it immutable
entries.transaction_boundary: one SqliteUnitOfWork transaction: evidence + evidence_lifecycle + run_criterion_evidence + command_idempotency + events/event_outbox (evidence.imported, aggregate_version = max+1); sync db.query inside tx.write (thenables rejected by assertSync)
entries.rollback: any throw rolls back all writes; unexpected persistence failures wrapped in IMPORT_FAILED; never writes task-run state or completion decisions; harness run ids never become canonical run ids
